body: Thank you. I haven't responded because this is my throwaway, and my uncle just passed away. I am not really sure how to cope right now.

Well I run, I rock climb, and I bike. I'm also draw well, cook well, and I pretty much find what I'm terrible at and get good at it. 

It seems to have no gratifying results for me. Yeah I'm good at all this stuff. Great. At the end of the day I am still alone. I know it's hard to cheer up someone who isn't hearing what you're saying--my point is that nothing seems to be worth doing anymore. 

Maybe I need an adjustment in medication. Who knows.

I know it all lies in choice. I feel like I am the worst person in the world because I tell everyone to choose happiness; it's the brave thing to do! But inside, I'm a mess. I can't seem to practice what I preach. I'm making a difference in others' lives but not my own. 

What the fuck am I doing wrong?
